name: Live Share Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Live Share Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow only company domain accounts
properties.description:
Prevents users from being able to share their session with any guests who are not part of their company or any other company that has been given access. Users must be logged in with their company email to access Live Share. If this policy is disabled, any user from any organization can access a shared Live Share session. Use ; to separate out multiple domains. For example, set the domain name as contoso.com or contoso.com;foo.com 
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Disable anonymous guests
properties.description:
Disallow anonymous guests from joining a session. Live Share already has the “Live Share: Anonymous Guest Approval” setting, and so this policy is effectively just enforcing that to “reject”.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Disable Chat
properties.description:
Prevent the host and guest from using chat within the session.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Disable shared read write terminal
properties.description:
Prevent the host from being able to explicitly share a new writeable terminal.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Disable shared server
properties.description:
Prevent the host from being able to explicitly share a new server. The policy also enforces “Live Share: Auto Share Servers” setting to false.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Require direct connection
properties.description:
Prevents hosts from allowing relay-based guests from joining their session. Live Share already supports the “Live Share: Connection Mode” setting, and so this policy is effectively just enforcing it to “direct”. If this policy is disabled, the host can allow relay-based guests to join their session if the host has not configured the “Live Share: Connection Mode” setting.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies

properties.name: Require guest approval
properties.description:
Guest can join the session only after host approves. Live Share already has the “Live Share: Guest Approval required” setting, and so this policy is effectively just enforcing that to “true”.
For more information, see: https://aka.ms/vsls-policies
